claims.feature: Title Case in AP, APA, Chicago or MLA style
tests: ui:text-case-converter:Title style picks AP, APA, Chicago or MLA rules, labels the row and applies them
unit:textcase:title case style guides: AP and APA capitalise 4+ letter words, Chicago and MLA lower-case all prepositions, APA leaves a short last word

claims.feature: UPPER, lower, Sentence, Title, aLtErNaTiNg and inverse case, plus 10 identifier styles converted line by line
tests: ui:text-case-converter:identifier list converts per line; apply and undo

claims.feature: Word, character, sentence and paragraph counts with reading time
tests: ui:text-case-converter:word count, reading time and keywords on real prose
ui:text-case-converter:empty input shows example conversions and zero counts

claims.feature: Line tools: remove duplicates, natural sort, trim, remove blank lines
tests: ui:text-case-converter:line tools: dedupe and natural sort

gaps: Convert Case also makes decorative Unicode text (bold, italic, cursive and upside-down letters) and Morse code; Layerbit does not, because those characters break screen readers and search.
Title Case Converter covers more style guides (for example AMA, Bluebook and Wikipedia); Layerbit has AP, APA, Chicago and MLA.
